target.name: Clippership
target.founder: Nico Cymbalist, Luca Cymbalist, Kai Matsuka

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Clippership is a Seed-stage maritime technology company that has raised $5M+. The private comp universe for ocean and maritime frontier tech remains sparse, with only three identified private peers (Standard Subsea, NetworkOcean, and Albacore) and no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

The valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression method, the sole applicable framework given data constraints. Using total capital raised of $5M as a proxy for post-money valuation, a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage implies a valuation of $12M. This reflects normalized dilution and milestone-based value creation expected between rounds in early-stage venture capital.

The triangulated valuation range is $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This narrow band reflects limited methodological diversity—the analysis is constrained by the absence of public comps, sparse private peer data, and unavailable financial metrics from the private peer set. Key uncertainties include the actual post-money valuation of the initial Seed round, applicable revenue multiples or margin profiles for maritime tech operators, and relative competitive positioning against the three identified private peers. Further validation would require access to comparable transaction multiples or peer-level unit economics.
